neighbours.label: probe / probing / pry: investigating something by questioning or examining
fire: Reporters kept probing the senator about the missing funds.
The committee will probe the causes of the bridge collapse.
Please do not pry into your neighbor's private affairs.
Detectives probed the suspect's alibi for several hours.
Her questions were probing and made the witness nervous.
Researchers want to probe how memory changes with age.
An official inquiry into the accident began on Monday.
He hated it when relatives would pry about his salary.
quiet: Reporters kept asking the senator about the missing funds.
The committee will discuss the causes of the bridge collapse.
Please do not complain about your neighbor's private affairs.
Detectives checked the suspect's alibi for several hours.
Her questions were friendly and made the witness relaxed.
Researchers want to know how memory changes with age.
An official meeting about the accident began on Monday.
He hated it when relatives would talk about his salary.

notes: card: ' probing' x7, ' probe' x6, 'pro|bed', ' pry', ' inquiry'. Quiet items keep the investigation context but use other verbs.
